lines.en: It is a check that catches fake apartment names.

lines.ko: 두 이름이 다르면 3을 주고 멈추게 했습니다.
lines.en: If two names differed, it returned 3 and stopped early.
But 3 sat inside the too-similar range.
I changed the stop signal, and warnings dropped to 0.
Real complex, or a made-up name?
From plan to working game in one day.

captions.ko: 아파트 이름이 진짜인지 지어낸 건지 맞히는 퀴즈를 하루 만에 만들었습니다. 가짜 이름을 걸러 내는 검사가 엉뚱하게 222건을 경고한 이유는 멈춤 신호로 쓴 숫자 3이었습니다.
captions.en: Built a quiz about real versus made-up apartment names in a single day. The check meant to catch look-alike fakes threw 222 false alarms, all because the early-stop signal was the number 3.
